name: mega-sitemap-footer
title: Mega Sitemap Footer
description: A comprehensive multi-column site directory footer with legal links, social handles, and system status indicator.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Mega Sitemap Footer Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
